tower._: The sketch of 25 November 2026: a three-storey podium over the lot (a taller ground floor and two residential levels) and the tower to 12 storeys, 6 m off our northern boundary (66-68 Riley St), 3 m off Riley Street and Crown Lane, 5 m off Stanley Lane as drawn. No apartment layout is given for this footprint, so its apartments are read in 8 m bays along its walls.

site._units: About 105: the 8,920 m² GFA the sketch's massing gives (a three-storey podium and the tower to 12), at 85 m² an apartment, as the neighbours' yields are counted.
